verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an authentication and identity platform, so asynchronous human approval of agent transactions (CIBA-style) is a fair axis for it. The evidence never documents CIBA, backchannel authentication, or per-transaction approval for agents. The OAuth Device Authorization Flow, MFA enrollment, and MCP server access via AuthKit are adjacent login and authorization features, not human-in-the-loop confirmation of sensitive agent actions, so they earn no credit.
